notes.title: Mage Mayhem 3.0
notes.content:
[h1]RE[u][/u]LEASE NOTES[/h1]

[u][h2]Game Modes[/h2][/u]
[h3]General Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stats have been reworked, adjustments to values have been made along with adding more stat points for each category.
[*] [b]Runes[/b] a new upgrade category,  causing abilities to act in new ways, such as applying burn, frost, duplicating, shooting homing missiles, and more.

[*] Chests only show you abilities you own

[*] Added a minimap, indicating where to go for the next level and highlighting enemies and chests
[/list]

[u][h2]General[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] New UI for the lobby
[*] Enemies now have healthbars
[*] Changed crosshair
[*] Minor color scheme adjustments
[*] Survival is the default game mode for PvE
[*] Other various nerfs and adjustments
[/list]

notes.title: Mage Mayhem Patch 2.0
notes.content:
[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]

[h2]Maps and Modes[/h2]

[h3]Survival[Game Mode][/h3]

Survival is the new roguelike game mode where players can mix and match upgrades to fend off a wide variety of enemies. The enemies get stronger in number and power as the game goes on with a line combat and boss fight mixed in! Enemies can be upgraded themselves giving more health, damage, armor, and special effects. Discover unique upgrade combinations to reach the highest wave on the leaderboards.
[list]
[*]There are over 90 upgrades ranging from simple damage upgrades to completely reworking abilities. 
[*]Perks are disabled in the game mode.
[*] Mayhem and Empower are disabled.
[*] Can only be played on the map The Valley.
[/list]

[h3]The Valley[Map][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302144/1840d1d1194ec8f681489a4c6bd28c1925babab0.png[/img]
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Every class's most basic repeatable attack has been allocated its own slot and is not changeable. Their damage has been reduced, and their mana cost is now zero.
[list]
[*] Icebolt damage 7->4, cost 2->0
[*] Swipe damage 3->1, bleed per tick 1.3 -> 1, cost 2->0
[*] Fireball damage 3->2, damage per tick 2-> 1.5 cost 2->0
[*] Cannonball damage 6->3, cost 4.5->0, slow duration 2->1
[*] Harmony's Paradox damage/healing 4.5->2, cost 4->0
[*] Justice damage 4.5 -> 2.5, cost 2.5->0
[*] Death's Gambit damage 5.5->2.5, cost 4->0, third attack damage 9->5
[*] Sinister Beckoning damage 5.5 -> 2.5, cost 5.5 -> 1
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]QoL Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Many visual overhauls including group health bars, menus, buttons, and more.
[/list]

Discover unique upgrade combinations to reach the highest wave on the leaderboards.

notes.title: Mage Mayhem Patch 1.5.1 Balance Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]RELEASE NOTES[/b][/h1]

The goal of this update is to decrease the length of matches and make it easier to capitalize on advantages you make and allow for punishing players who are out of position. In order to do this we decreased multiple healing abilities and increase damage of many underperforming abilities. Running backward while shooting has become less effective as now you have reduced movement speed when doing so, additionally getting shot in the back applies a 10% slow for 1 second.

[h2][b]CLASS BALANCE[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Grave Warden[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Death's Gambit cooldown 1.25 -> 1.6
[*] Death's Ricochet damage 8 -> 7, cooldown 13 -> 15
[*] Death Touch cooldown 3 -> 3.5
[/list]
[i]Grave Warden was able to do too much damage at a range, additionally his combo of Death Touch and Death's Gambit was too strong so these changes aim to reduce his ability spam and ranged effectiveness[/i]

[h3][b]Druid[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Rejuvenation healing per tick 3.5 -> 3
[*] Nature's Mend heal 14->16
[*] Harmony's Paradox damage to enemies 4.5 -> 5.5
[*]Hurricane damage 7->7.5 per tick
[/list]

[h3][b]Pirate Captain[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Undying Pact base heal 5 ->3
[*] Parrot Toss initial hit damage 4->5, second hit damage 10 ->12
[*] Wave damage 7->9.5
[/list]

[h3][b]Ice Magus[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Max Health 100->85
[*] Ice wave damage 16->18
[*] Frost debuff damage 4->8
[*] Superconductive Mass damage 12 -> 14, cooldown 8->10 seconds
[/list]

[h3][b]Fire Mage[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Embers charges 3->5, damage 4->3.5
[/list]

[h3][b]Paladin[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] From the Heaven's damage 10->11, upgrade damage now increased by 4 of the base damage, cooldown 7->6 seconds, cost 9->8 mana
[/list]

[h3][b]General Balance Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Strafing/walking backwards has decreased movement speed
[*] Getting hit from behind applies slow
[/list]

[h2][b]NEW GAME MODE[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] EMPOWER - During the match there will be ramping up damage amplification and decreased healing by 10% every 30-60 seconds depending on game mode, up to a max of 50% for each. This can be selected alongside Mayhem in the Lobby Menu.
[/list]

notes.title: MAGE MAYHEM: PALADIN AND ASSASSIN UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1][b]RELEASE NOTES[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]NEW CHARACTERS[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]ASSASSIN[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Focus on high melee burst and weaving in and out of combat with stealth. 
[*] Tailor your preferred playstyle with a dynamic passive that changes based on the abilities you take. Taking Stealth grants high burst damage when exiting Stealth, however if you don't have a stealth ability then gain permanent increased backstab damage to execute enemies.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302144/d94c24264b0103639d854c47e3de810b956ec42e.png[/img]

[h3][b]PALADIN[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Protect your allies, being a beacon of light for them. Redirect damage, knock enemies away, anything to protect your teammates.
[*] Swing your mighty hammer lowering the cooldown and cast time as you cast. When needed you can sacrifice these bonuses to upgrade your other abilities providing additional effects to turn the tides of battle drastically.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302144/8ea0b15bb032c73d12721b0b0e6a73808e806b9f.png[/img]

[h2][b]CLASS BALANCE[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Pirate[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Surge - damage/healing decreased from 8 -> 6,5
[*]Parrot Toss - projectile speed increased drastically, additionally also stuns for 1 second
[*]Wave - now only roots targets that have already been slowed, otherwise it just slows. Wave now slightly climbs terrain as well.
[*] Bottle toss - Armor decreased from 7->5 (10% decrease)
[/list]

[h3][b]Ice Mage[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Frost Nova - Decrease damage from 8->4
[*] Frost Debuff - Decrease damage from 10->4, additionally now has a 5 second cooldown before it can be reapplied
[*] Ice Wave - Decrease damage from 20->16
[*] Superconductive Mass - Decrease damage from 15->12
[*] Updated Ice Storm's damage info to properly indicate its per projectile damage of 4 (previously read 20 which had no relevance).
[*] Shard Burst - Now applies 2 stacks of Frost for the first projectile that hits an enemy, consecutive hits will not apply frost but still deal damage.
[/list]

[h3][b]Trapper[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Sinister Beckoning - Higher chance for players to successfully be launched to traps.
[/list]

[h3][b]Grave Warden[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Max Health -  125 -> 115
[*] Trample - Casting Movement Speed from 20% slow -> 5% movement increase, Increase AoE size, Increase slow amount of fire from 25->35%, damage per tick decrease from 2.1 -> 1.9, cast time decrease from 3.9 -> 3 seconds
[*] Necrofury - Remove 1 status effect -> Gain 20% increased movement speed for 2 seconds
[/list]

[h2][b]PERK BALANCE[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Mending Step - healing decreased from 10->7.5
[/list]

[h2][b]QoL[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Wait 30 seconds before starting the game and releasing players that are spawned/connected to play or if everyone has connected wait 5 seconds to start the game.
[*] Improved spectating further with seeing their health bar, and following their camera rotation
[*] Added a spectator option in lobbies
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
[h1][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]NEW CLASS[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]PIRATE[/b][/h3]
Enjoy the new utility/support character, the Pirate Captain. Toss out cannonballs, treasure chests, kegs, and conjure waves and water explosions to disrupt your enemies and buff your allies!

[h2][b]CLASS BALANCE[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Fire Mage[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Condensed Flame cd 3 -> 7 seconds
[*]Plasma Beam range 650 -> 1200, 2 dmg -> 1.8 dmg per tick, 1.75 sec CD -> 2 sec CD, 1.65 mana cost -> 2 mana cost per second
[*]Firesling visual update and projectile velocity changed from 1500 to 1750
[*]Flareburst visual update
[/list]

[h3][b]Trapper[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Passive Void Pulse will fire at everyone hit by a trap (previously only the person who activated the trap).
[/list]

[h3][b]Ice Mage[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Crystal Mist - Mana 15->20, cooldown 17 -> 18 seconds, Casting Time 1s -> .85s, explosion damage 5->8 +50% of the affected projectile's damage( Additional Information: Affected projectiles no longer unaffected when mist disappears. Splash radius of crystal explosion scales with affected projectile's splash radius. Affected projectiles will immediately deal the crystal explosion damage and effects if prematurely hitting a target or surface before detonating. Damage is maximized after 1.5 seconds of being affected.)
[/list]

[h2][b]QoL[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Death to the Lone Mayhem event does half your max hp, however will never kill you instead leaving you at 1hp.
[*]Implemented Passwords for lobby hosting
[*]Changed rooting to no longer stop players midair, and can no longer dodge while rooted
[*]Added a setting for lobbies to stop players from joining a match in progress if enabled
[*]Fixed an issue where you could move while dead
[/list]

notes.title: Mayhem Hotfix Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix lava spawn on clients
[*] Fix Orbital Assault persisting through death if you get killed by roundstart menu
[*] Buff Battle Hardened from 3% damage and 1 armor to 7% damage and 1.5 armor
[*] Increase all event durations to 45
[*] Decrease time between mayhems to 45-60 seconds
[*] If a MAYHEM event occurs, removes it from the pool of events
[*] Druid - Heal mana cost increased from 10 to 15
[*] Condensed Flame - mana cost increased from 3 to 8, cooldown increased from 3 to 7, damage decreased from 12 to 10, and burn decreased from 3dmg/s for 3 seconds to 2dmg/s for 3 seconds

notes.title: MAYHEM UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302144/d5a8a3d96f9d12ff701a961decd86f22b8512214.png[/img][h1][b]RELEASE NOTES[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]CLASS BALANCE[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Trapper[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] NEW ABILITY Cluster Bomb - Toss a projectile which upon contact with an enemy or surface will explode into a cluster of small bouncing bombs.
[*] NEW ABILITY Shadow Drone - Deploy a drone of your own creation to aid you in trapping targets. Striking an enemy with the drone will activate it immediately and briefly stun the target, otherwise after it will activate in after a moment. Once activated the drone is stationary and will search for nearby enemies to beam down.
[*] Void Pulse - Casts faster, can move at full speed while casting, and pierces
[*] Sinister Beckoning - When hitting a target that is not near any traps deal 50% increased damage, additionally improved the tossing in to trap effect to be more reliable
[*] Bash - Can now bounce the user off of terrain and additionally improved its hitbox
[/list]

[h3][b]Tank[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Death Touch - now evenly applies damage over its .3 second channel time, lowered cooldown from 5 seconds to 3 seconds, increased damage from 6 to 7.5 total damage
[*] Shield Toss - Damage from 7 -> 8, ability is now faster and homes very accurately after the first hit
[/list]

[h3][b]Ice Mage[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] NEW ABILITY Frost Nova - Create an area inflicting frost and slow to every enemy within.
[/list]

[h3][b]Healer[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] NEW ABILITY Lightning Wisp - Transform in to a wisp, gaining the ability to pass through enemies. Each enemy you pass through gets hit with lighting once you transform back in to Druid form.
[*] Hurricane - damage increased from 6 -> 7
[/list]

[h2][b]PERKS[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] NEW PERK Mending Step - Dodging now provides immunity during the duration and dodging an attack during the immunity also grants 10 health regeneration over 10 seconds
[*] NEW PERK Orbital Assault - Everytime you land an attack, an orb cycles around you. Everytime you receive a hit one orb is removed. Once 9 orbs are reached they all fly outward toward the closest enemy character dealing .8 damage per orb.
[/list]

[h2][b]NEW FEATURE[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]MAYHEM EVENTS[/b][/h3]
The Elder Wizards grow tired of watching pitiful duels between lesser beings. They summon great magic periodically to see who the strongest, most adaptable wizard is. There will be six events upon release:
[list]
[*]Meteor Shower - Meteors rain freely from the sky damaging anyone who gets caught by them
[*]Lava Floor - Lava slowly raises from the ground, slowing and damaging anyone caught in it
[*]Crystals - Crystals spawn at random and provide one random buff or debuff to anybody who collides with them
[*]Death to the Lone - 5 seconds after the event begins anybody who is alone instantly is killed
[*]Battle Hardened - If you have more kills than deaths gain a supercharge buff for 3% for each kill, if you have more deaths than kills gain an armor buff giving 1 armor for each death. If deaths and kills are even gain half of each buff. This buff lasts 90 seconds or until death.
[*]Capture Point - Spawn additional capture points for the rest of the match, anyone standing in them takes 1 damage per second, but generates points for their team.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302144/6022661ac73d86b3452c21f2d79b5fdc4f7a3920.png[/img]
[h2][b]NEW MAP[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]The Bazaar[/b][/h3]
The largest map yet for large scale fights! Enjoy raised platforms to fight on and a giant castle in the center to defend!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302144/72f7f802c897e56aac93796c181859cb4d0ff492.png[/img]

[h2][b]QOL IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Created an indicator setting which creates a permanent moving circle on the ground where your casts will be
[*]Created an option to show hitboxes for abilities which may not be completely clear
[*]Added loadouts to the round start menu(menu in between rounds/deaths)
[*]Improved Spectating, can now rotate between spectated targets and improved the camera
[*]Added motion blur setting

[/list]

notes.title: MAYHEM UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302144/d6ad3f34ee2b730c5ce49a5ee8c8ec339f7ca604.png[/img]
Mage Mayhem patch 1.3 is a large gameplay update patch bringing in new features, abilities and perks. The planned release date for the patch is on or before August 10th.

[h1][b]RELEASE NOTES[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]MAYHEM EVENTS[/b][/h2]
The Elder Wizards grow tired of watching pitiful duels between lesser beings. They summon great magic periodically to see who the strongest, most adaptable wizard is. There will be six events upon release: [list]
[*]Meteor Shower
[*]Lava Floor
[*]Crystals
[*]Death to the Lone
[*]Battle Hardened
[*]Capture Point
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302144/f11abaf10c8567d04abafddac81c6ad79663a37e.png[/img]
These events main goal are to speed up matches that are dragging, and cause MAYHEM.

[h2][b]PERK AND ABILITY CHANGES[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]CLASS BALANCE[/b][/h3]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302144/032a2c154b362dc02b4e62eaa02320582e9aa60d.png[/img]
[*] Trapper is receiving a mini rework along with two new abilities, Cluster Bomb and Shadow Drone. This mini rework provides more AoE damage and makes abilities feel more responsive and consistent.
[*] Tank's Death Touch and Shield Toss have been changed to make them easier to use.
[*] Druid received a new ability, Lightning Wisp, which provides increased movement through enemies and AoE damage.
[*] Ice Mage received a new ability, Frost Nova, which provides AoE slow and Frost debuff application.
[/list]
[h3][b]PERKS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Mending Step - a defensive perk which allows for invulnerability frames on dodge.
[*] Orbital Assault - an offensive perk rewarding not being hit with giving more damage.
[/list]

[h2][b]QoL IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2]
Options for visual clarity improvements on abilities and casting, improved spectating, improved targeting for Druid, and much more!

This is just an overview of what is in store and a more detailed release of patch notes will be supplied once the actual patch is released.

[previewyoutube=T4hwRiYurNk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Mage Mayhem Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[b]Class Balance[/b]

[u]Fire Mage[/u]
[list]
[*] Tremor - Decreased time it takes for ability's waves to activate.
[*] Fire Tornado - Removed pull in effect, however made it chase the closest nearby player
[*] Flare Burst - Ability description Updated
[/list]

[u]Healer[/u]
[list]
[*] Gaian Protection - Cooldown changed from 15 seconds -> 13 seconds
[*] Twin Roots - Root duration from 8 seconds -> 5 seconds
[*] Supercharge - Cast time changed from 2 seconds -> 1 second
[*] [b]NEW ABILITY[/b] Hurricane - Conjure a storm around the user, occasionally zapping nearby enemy players dealing damage.
[/list]

[u]Tank[/u]
[list]
[*] Armor decreased from 2.5 -> 1.8
[*] Passive lifesteal - Changed from 15% -> 12%
[*] Necrofury - Changed shield color to increase visual clarity between it and spectral shield
[*] [b]NEW ABILITY[/b] Death Touch - The forces of the undead upheave the ground below a small area in front of you damaging and slowing enemies.

[i]Developer note - another basic ability to make the base tank class more beginner friendly, replacing the shield in the Tank's basic loadout [/i]
[/list]

[u]Trapper[/u]
[list]
[*] Spin - Cooldown decreased from 20 seconds -> 15 seconds
[/list]

[u]Ice Mage[/u]
[list]
[*] Glacial Comet - Ability description updated
[/list]



[b] Miscellaneous [/b]
[list]
[*] Keybindings for moving and jumping added
[*] Decrease Team Death Match score required to win to 7
[*] Increase time between rounds to 20
[*] Added mouse inversion settings in the gameplay menu
[*] Added a menu in the scoreboard menu to show your currently selected abilities
[*] Added character select to round over screen
[*] Each Map got additional Team 1/Team 2 spawn locations to prevent spawning inside of other players. Additionally more Free For All points were added as well to help spread players out.
[*] Chat messages will remain for 60 seconds (was 25 seconds before)
[*] Fixed Tab Targeting crashing the game as soon as you hit tab when entering the game
[*] Fixed dying with abilities on cooldown visual bug
[*] Tooltip text added on team to show players that it may be buggy.
[*] Method of keeping track and adding assists to those who've damage a target in the past 7 seconds, assist is added to them when they die
[*] Restructured the ability select list so the basic abilities are first
[*] Last Map and Game mode are saved when returning to lobby
[*] Last Cast Perk buffed
[*] Moved feedback button out the chat in Main Menu
[/list]
